page.overview:
Who is USS Constance personnel?

The following personnel served aboard the .

This female lieutenant served on the Constance during the Battle of Wolf 359. During the battle, she made her way down to the life deck, where Ensign Liam Shaw and his fellow shipmates were. Knowing there was only one life pod left, the lieutenant randomly picked 10 people from the group of shipmates, including Shaw himself. She ordered the ten selected to get into the life pod, and stayed behind on the doomed ship. Long after the battle, Shaw, experiencing severe survivor guilt due to the loss of not only her but the other 39 who stayed behind, wondered why she had chosen him over herself. ()
